title: A 14-Year-Old Won Wildlife Photographer of the Year With a Dung Beetle
excerpt: Oscar Whitfield's black-and-white Labour of Love proves the extraordinary hides inside the ordinary. His technique was humble: lie flat, get to eye level, and shoot fast.

title: Your Photography Website Needs One Job
excerpt: Portfolio, print store, workshop hub, blog. One homepage cannot do all of those jobs well. The fix is a single question: what is the primary job this space is meant to do?

title: Every Flash Photo Is Really Two Exposures
excerpt: Photographer JC Carey breaks flash down to a repeatable decision order: set the ambient with the camera, set the subject with the strobe, and never let the two argue.
